== Biography ==

Five is one of the three gardeners employed to paint the white roses in the Queen's garden red. He speaks in a sulky tone and, when paint splatters across the work, attributes the mishap to his companion Seven, claiming Seven jogged his elbow. Seven dismisses this excuse, retorting that Five is forever laying the blame on others rather than owning his own mistakes. Their exchange suggests an uneasy familiarity born of shared employment and shared peril under the Queen's service.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. An observer of the gardeners at their work in the rose garden.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. The gardeners fear the Queen's wrath should she discover their mistake in planting a white rose-tree instead of a red one.

'''[[Seven]]''' — acquaintance. A fellow gardener; their interactions suggest friction, with Seven accusing Five of laying blame on others.

'''[[Two]]''' — acquaintance. A fellow member of the gardening trio.
